chunks: Ali ibn Ahmad narrated to us, saying: Ubaydullah ibn Musa al-Alawi narrated from some of his men, from Ibrahim ibn al-Hakam ibn Dhaheer, from Isma'il ibn Ayyash, from al-A'mash, from Abu Wa'il, who said:

Amir al-Mu'minin Ali looked at al-Husayn and said: 'Indeed, this son of mine is a master, as the Messenger of Allah called him a master. Allah will bring forth from his loins a man with the name of your Prophet, who resembles him in physical appearance and character. He will emerge while people are in heedlessness, with the truth being suspended and oppression being displayed. By Allah, if he did not emerge, I would strike his neck [or: I would be struck on the neck]. The inhabitants of the heavens and their residents will rejoice at his emergence. He is a man with a bright forehead, a hooked nose, a large abdomen, wide thighs, with a mole on his right thigh, and with separated front teeth. He will fill the earth with justice, just as it was filled with tyranny and oppression.'

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (title for Imam Ali)
key_terms.يَمْلَأُ الْأَرْضَ عَدْلًا: he will fill the earth with justice

ai.seo_question: What are the physical and spiritual characteristics of the Mahdi as described in this hadith from Imam Ali?
ai.summary: This narration from Al-Nu'mani’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* highlights the eschatological significance of Imam al-Husayn’s lineage, specifically identifying the Mahdi as the 'Sayyid' whose emergence is so pivotal that its delay would warrant his execution. It underscores the Shia belief in the Mahdi’s physical resemblance to the Prophet Muhammad and his universal mission to establish justice, a theme deeply rooted in the concept of *Adl* (Divine Justice) within Twelver scholarship.

en.abdullah-al-shahin: (2) Ali bin Ahmad narrated from Obaydillah bin Musa al-Alawi from some of his companions from Ibraheem bin al-Hakam bin Dhaheer from Issma’eel bin Ayyash from al-A’mash that Abu Wa’il had said:

Once Amirul Mo’mineen (as) looked at his son al-Husayn (as) and said: “My son is a master as the Prophet (S) has called him a master. Allah will make one of his (al-Husayn’s) descendants, whose name will be like the Prophet’s name and who will be like the Prophet (S) in form and morals, appear while people are in advertence, the truth is suspended and oppression is spread everywhere. The inhabitants of the heaven and the people of the earth will be happy with his advent. He is a man with bright forehead, hooked nose, big abdomen, wide thighs with a mole on the right thigh and with separated front teeth. He will fill the world with justice after it has been filled with injustice and oppression.”
